[/b][/i][i][b]The included tractor textures are based on the [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]﻿][/b][/i][i][b]assets, which are released under the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/TractorMod/LICENSE]MIT License[/url]﻿. [/b][/i][i][b]
[/b][/i][i][b]If your recolor is derived from these assets, you can include[/b][/i][i][b]a link to the Tractor Mod page to respect the license.[/b][/i][i][b]
[/b][/i][i][b]Pathoschild was kind enough to allow me to upload this using their assets![/b][/i][i][b]
[/b][/i][i][b]even if you make your own assets if you utilize this template you must link back to both mine and Pathoschild's nexus profile![/b][/i][i][b]
[/b][/i][i][b]All Mods i upload are free of charge to use[/b][/i][b]
[i]All I ask for using this mod is both credit myself and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild?gameId=1303]pathoschild [/url]﻿for this mod and to link your retexture using this template to this page so i can link them on my page![/i]
[/b][b]

[/b][/quote][b][/b]


Hello!

With the help and permission from the lovely author of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] Pathoschild I set up a template for others to create seasonal recolors of the following assets:

1. Tractor

2. Buff Icon

3. Garage 

4. Icon[/center][u]
[/u][center][u]How to use:

[/u]1. Download the file and unzip.

2. Open the image into an editing program that allows transparent backgrounds and layers. (i use the program aseprite but use anything ya want with layers at least!)

3. Make any and all color changes and/or retextures of your choice!

4. Edit the manifest(s) with your own information.

5. Save it, zip it and upload it.6. Link your recolor in the comments, I'd love to see em and any edits you guys make I'll add it to my page so others can find it! If ya wanna include any images to this mod? let me know and i'll likely add them!

Hints if you're having trouble:

1. the vanilla stable and horse are the same size as the garage and tractor respectively! 

2. this isn't just for mod authors! users can use this if you can't choose between tractor recolor mods![/center]
